text:
Ava P. (Product): Heads up 1: Acme asked to tighten service guarantees for their chat pilot. They want p99 dropped ~45% and stable error surface during pilot. This will affect runtime, infra, and a security review. Need owners, rough estimates, and launch criteria by EOD Wed so we can update roadmap.

Rajat (Eng Runtime): Quick take: main levers are KV warm paths + selective kernel choice + request batching policy. I estimate ~8 dev-days across 2 engineers for the runtime workstream, plus 2 full perf campaigns. We'll need a representative prompt set (not prod data).

Maya (Infra): Infra impact: we should create a warm-node pool (short lived instances) and adjust scale-in grace to avoid cold evictions. Provision + test = ~6 infra-days. Also need quota bump requests for burst nodes.

Liam (Security): Security scope: verify masking/redaction for user messages, confirm telemetry filters, and ensure no plaintext artifact in logs or metrics. I can run the checklist in ~3 days after getting sample payloads. If Acme requests retention exceptions, legal is required.

Ken (Eng Platform): Rolling this out requires a canary route + automatic fallback. My plan: 3-step rollout (internal perf -> 1% canary -> 10% canary -> full). I'll add trace propagation and a tracing tag to measure per-tenant p99. ETA: 5 working days for platform bits.

Noah (SRE): From ops: add short-term alerts for p99 spikes and tail-worker OOMs. Also a runbook entry for manual rollbacks during pilot. I can stand up alerts in 1 day once thresholds are decided.

Ava P. (Product): Proposed acceptance criteria: (a) p99 down >=40% on Acme canonical tests, (b) no >0.1% error increase during canary, (c) security sign-off on masking, (d) cost uplift <=30% for token compute. Agree owners?

Rajat (Eng Runtime): I can own runtime changes and perf validation. I'll produce a perf dashboard and link the run artifacts. Runtime checklist: 
- implement warm-kv path toggle
- kernel selector flag
- perf harness job + dataset pointer
Config snippet for runtime flagging:
```yaml
perf_flags:
  kernel_mode: "fast-tail"
  kv_warm: true
  max_batch_latency_ms: 8
```

Maya (Infra): I'll own warm-node pool + autoscale windows. Need projected RPS curve from product to size pool. Also will post cost delta estimate.

Liam (Security): I'll own masking review and telemetry filters. Action: get sample payloads & retention policy from Acme.

Ken (Eng Platform): I'll own canary wiring and fallback routing. Will file PR and reference INF-4491.

Noah (SRE): I'll own alerts and runbook edits. Suggest thresholds: p99 > 500ms above baseline triggers page.

Ava P. (Product): Timeline ask from Acme: pilot launch in 3 weeks. Realistic?

Rajat (Eng Runtime): Tight but doable if parallel. Perf cycles are the gating factor. Need immediate dataset and 2-week window for kernel tuning.

Maya (Infra): If approvals for quota and budget happen this week, infra can be ready in 9 business days. Otherwise +2w.

Liam (Security): 3 business days for initial review after payloads arrive. Legal dependency may add time.

Ken (Eng Platform): Platform work can land in ~6 business days; canary config is quick once runtime flags exist.

Ava P. (Product): Draft plan we can commit to: 
- Today: Acme to share sanitized samples (Ava)
- Tue: runtime perf job queued (Rajat)
- Thu: infra PR for warm pool (Maya)
- Next Mon: security checklist draft (Liam)
- Next Tue: platform canary PR (Ken)
- Next Wed: SRE alerts + runbook (Noah)
- Target pilot: 3 weeks from today, +1 week contingency
Owners: runtime=Rajat, infra=Maya, security=Liam, platform=Ken, ops=Noah, product=Ava.

Rajat (Eng Runtime): I'll open PERF-612 and attach the prompt set.

Maya (Infra): I'll open INF-4491 and include cost delta.

Liam (Security): I'll post the checklist doc and tag legal if retention exceptions appear.

Ken (Eng Platform): deploy-bot: will need INF ticket reference for canary route. Adding INF-4491 to PR.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Canary route creation requires infra approval and an INF ticket. Please include a link to the PR and operator runbook.

Noah (SRE): I'll pre-create the alerting rules and link them to the runbook.

Ava P. (Product): Thanks team. We'll reconvene Tue morning after the first perf run. Keep notes short in the PERF-612 thread. :rocket:
